visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a pink sleeveless dress, glasses, and a pearl necklace, performs expressive, rhythmic dance movements in a sunlit public park. The setting features green trees, a paved brick walkway, and a distant white architectural structure. Yellow and white text banners are visible at the bottom and top of the frame. (2) The scene shifts to a medium close-up of the same woman speaking into a yellow microphone held by an unseen person. Her facial expressions are animated, with frequent hand gestures. The background remains the park environment with soft, bright daylight filtering through the trees. (3) A man with short dark hair and tattoos on his shoulders, wearing a black tank top, is seen indoors in front of a mirror. He is holding a small portable fan and laughing while another man in a white t-shirt interacts with him. The lighting is bright and indoor-focused. (4) The woman from the first phase is joined by a female reporter with glasses and several other individuals in the park. They are performing synchronized dance moves. A graphic overlay featuring a square image and promotional text appears on the screen. (5) High-contrast graphic slides with text and dates are displayed, followed by a final shot of the group dancing and the reporter speaking to the camera in the park.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo, upbeat pop BGM with a strong drum machine beat begins immediately. A professional-sounding male narrator delivers a news-style introduction at a steady rate. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition as a woman's voice, higher in pitch and expressive with some melodic rising contours, begins explaining her story. (3) A cartoonish 'pop' sound effect occurs alongside speech. The woman’s voice becomes more animated as she describes her puppy. (4) A comic 'hit' SFX highlights a comedic moment in the interview. A younger female voice (the reporter) asks a question with clear, casual articulation. (5) Transition SFX leads into a male voice with a warm, energetic tone. He speaks enthusiastically with high vocal arousal. (6) A shift in music occurs; the BGM transitions into a melodic, acoustic guitar-driven pop song with male vocals. The male narrator returns to provide information about a dance tour over the song. (7) Final segment features group shouting 'I want to be happy' synchronized with a rhythmic beat and ends with a concluding statement from the female reporter.
